name: Concerns Resource
description: A security finding concerns a resource on the grid (finding -> EC2 instance / S3 bucket / IAM user / IAM role), keyed by that resource's natural key: a GuardDuty finding's Resource.InstanceDetails.InstanceId, S3BucketDetails[].Arn, or an IAMUser access key's UserName (as arn:<partition>:iam::<account>:user/<name>, inferred: the default path); a Security Hub finding's Resources[].Id for AwsEc2Instance (the instance id from the ARN), AwsS3Bucket, AwsIamUser and AwsIamRole; an Access Analyzer finding's resource ARN for AWS::S3::Bucket, AWS::IAM::Role and AWS::IAM::User. A reference, not containment; it ends with the finding. Emitted whether or not the target was collected: it resolves by deterministic identity when it is. Collected by the landing-zone reader's findings half (collectors/boto3_collector/findings.py, aws-core-tap#76).
